selectionNote: Product ideas for exploring a look or routine. Shade, formula, personal tolerance and makeup removal still need checking. Choose the parts you like; these are not a confirmed personal match or a required shopping list.
audienceNote: Every guide is open to everyone. Choose a finish and technique you enjoy, regardless of gender.

makeup.title: Barely there
makeup.summary: Targeted coverage, brushed brows and a clear lip. Keep most of the complexion visible and make small, deliberate changes.
makeup.finish: Natural skin with selective shine control
makeup.colorNotes: A clear lip and a muted brow are the focus. The sample concealer shade is not a skin-tone match.
makeup.technique: Work on individual areas and soften the edges; leave areas you already like alone.

selections.reason: Dual-ended concealer for small areas of coverage; 0.5 N needs a personal shade check and net content remains unverified.
Grace Taupe brow mascara adds color while combing hairs; check the shade against your preferred brow color.
A translucent pressed powder for selective shine control; test how the finish looks on your complexion.
The Clear gloss gives shine without choosing a tinted lip shade; personal comfort and removal remain unverified.

steps: Choose a matching concealer and tap it only where you want extra coverage.
Comb brows in your preferred direction, adding a little tinted brow product where wanted.
Use powder only on areas you want less shiny; keep the remaining skin finish visible.
Finish with a small amount of clear gloss, or keep your own lip product.

brows.title: Brushed, lightly colored brows
steps: Comb hairs in their natural direction and add only enough brow color to create the definition you want.

eyes.title: Keep the eye area quiet
steps: Leave eye color optional; the brushed brow carries this minimal look.

nose.title: Small areas of coverage
steps: If you want coverage around the nose, blend a matching concealer along its edges and skip contour.

cheeks.title: Visible skin
steps: Keep cheeks mostly bare and use powder only where you prefer less shine.

lips.title: Clear shine
steps: Use a light layer of clear gloss without changing the lip outline.

makeup.title: Dewy glow
makeup.summary: A luminous complexion, cream cheek color and a glossy lip. Let reflected light be the main feature.
makeup.colorNotes: Rare Apple cheek color and Peony Ballet gloss are independent shade examples; compare their swatches before pairing.
makeup.technique: Build a thin luminous base, then concentrate extra shine on selected high points.

selections.reason: A luminous primer to explore before complexion makeup; how it layers with your own skincare is not verified.
A light-coverage glow cushion for an even-looking base; 10C Shell is an example shade, not a match.
A cream cheek format with a dewy finish; test Rare Apple color intensity and blending on your complexion.
A highlighting duo for selected facial high points; Cream Fizz needs a swatch check and net content is unverified.
A sheer color gloss to echo the luminous base; Peony Ballet color and personal comfort need checking.
An optional radiant finishing mist; it contains denatured alcohol, and tolerance or wear time is not guaranteed.

steps: Choose either the glow primer or your familiar preparation step, then apply a thin layer of a matching cushion.
Blend a little cream cheek color and check it in your usual light before adding more.
Place highlighter where you want extra reflection rather than covering the whole face.
Add a sheer gloss. If using the finishing mist, follow its label directions.

brows.title: Soft brow frame
steps: Keep brow edges softly brushed so the luminous complexion remains the focus.

eyes.title: Quiet eye color
steps: Keep eye color optional and restrained; use products labeled for the eye area if adding shine there.

nose.title: Choose your reflection
steps: Keep the nose at the base finish, or add a small highlight only where you want more reflection.

cheeks.title: Cream color and light
steps: Blend the cream cheek color first, then add a small highlight above the colored area.

lips.title: Sheer gloss
steps: Apply a sheer gloss layer and build the amount of shine to your preference.

makeup.title: Soft rose
makeup.summary: Pink eye color, a cool powder flush and softly outlined glossy lipstick. Keep transitions blended and the color story close.
makeup.finish: Soft satin complexion with a glossy lip
makeup.colorNotes: Prestige Pink, Odi Milk and Fairy Dream offer different pink references. They are not a tested matching set.
makeup.technique: Use light layers of color and soften the borders between the eye, cheek and lip accents.

selections.reason: A soft-satin cushion format for the base; shade 17N1 and the exact regional formula still need checking.
Prestige Pink combines eye, cheek and highlight colors; inspect the individual pans and follow their labeled uses.
Odi Milk adds a cool pastel powder flush; its light shade may read differently on your complexion.
Rosy Pink lip pencil gives the lip color a soft boundary; exact shade fit and net content remain unverified.
Fairy Dream is a glossy lipstick option for the pink story; it contains fragrance and personal comfort needs checking.

steps: Apply a matching base only to the coverage level you want.
Choose a light pink eye color and blend its edge; add a deeper palette shade only if you want more definition.
Build the powder blush gradually, or use the palette's cheek color as an alternative.
Soften the rosy pencil outline and add lipstick within it.

brows.title: A soft frame for pink
steps: Keep brow edges blended and retain visible individual hairs.

eyes.title: Diffused pink color
steps: Blend a light pink eye shade across the lid and soften the outer edge.

nose.title: Quiet satin base
steps: Keep the nose close to the base finish so the pink accents carry the look.

cheeks.title: Cool powder flush
steps: Build the pastel blush lightly and soften its border into the base.

lips.title: Soft outline, glossy color
steps: Blend the rosy liner edge before adding the glossy lipstick.

makeup.title: Soft smoky
makeup.summary: Black-brown lash-line depth, gray-brown brows and a muted mauve lip. A matte complexion keeps attention around the eyes.
makeup.finish: Matte complexion with blurred lip color
makeup.colorNotes: Black Brown liner, Gray Brown brows and Midnight Mauve lips create the contrast; brow and lip shades remain personal choices.
makeup.technique: Concentrate darkness close to the lash line and soften the visible edge instead of drawing a sharp wing.

selections.reason: A matte cushion for a quieter complexion finish; 10C Shell requires a shade match and net content is unverified.
Black Brown pencil places depth near the lashes; blending and wear vary, and its removal method remains unverified.
Gray Brown pencil adds restrained brow definition; choose a color you like rather than assuming it matches your hair.
Black Long Curling mascara adds lash definition; compatible removal and personal eye-area tolerance need checking.
Midnight Mauve gives a muted matte lip accent; the final color depends on your lips and application.
An optional setting powder for extra shine control; test the Clear shade's appearance before using it broadly.

steps: Choose a matching matte base and use the optional powder only where needed.
Draw a short black-brown line close to the lashes, then soften its outer edge while the texture allows.
Add fine brow strokes and lash definition without making every edge equally strong.
Blend a small amount of mauve tint across the lips for a soft finish.

brows.title: Muted brow definition
steps: Add gray-brown strokes to selected gaps, then blend the front edge.

eyes.title: Close, diffused depth
steps: Keep the black-brown liner close to the lashes and soften its visible edge rather than extending a sharp wing.

nose.title: Quiet matte finish
steps: Keep coverage thin around the nose and add powder only if you want less shine.

cheeks.title: Low-contrast cheeks
steps: Keep extra cheek color optional so the diffused eyes remain the focus.

lips.title: Muted mauve
steps: Blend the mauve tint lightly at the border for a soft matte accent.

makeup.title: Stage definition
makeup.summary: A defined black wing, fuller-looking lashes and concentrated eye sparkle. Add deliberate face shading and a glossy color accent.
makeup.finish: Even satin base with concentrated sparkle
makeup.colorNotes: Black liner and lashes supply the contrast. Choose a glitter pan and lip shade deliberately; the name of a style does not guarantee performance under stage lighting.
makeup.technique: Make selected edges crisp, then keep surrounding areas simpler so the definition is readable.

selections.reason: A fuller-coverage satin cushion base; 21N Ivory is an example shade and lighting can change its appearance.
A fine black brush liner for a crisp edge; the exact removal method remains unverified.
Volume Black mascara adds a stronger lash emphasis; net content, tolerance and compatible removal need checking.
Light & Glitter Garden provides ten glitter shades; check each shade and follow the product's eye-area directions.
Natural Brown shading creates optional face definition; swatch it first because depth and undertone are not personalized.
Vintage Apple glossy tint adds a distinct lip accent; it contains fragrance and the shade needs a personal check.

steps: Build a matching base in controlled layers and check the finished look in the lighting where you will wear it.
Draw a deliberate black wing and add mascara to the level of lash emphasis you want.
Choose one glitter accent and place it according to the product directions.
Add a small amount of face shading if desired, then finish with the glossy lip color.

brows.title: Deliberate brow frame
steps: Define the brow shape you want, then keep the inner edge softer than the tail.

eyes.title: Crisp wing and sparkle
steps: Combine a clear black liner edge with one concentrated glitter accent and fuller-looking lashes.

nose.title: Optional controlled shading
steps: If you want nose definition, use very little face shading and blend until no isolated stripe remains.

cheeks.title: Directional face shading
steps: Place shading only where you want more depth and check the contrast in your intended lighting.

lips.title: Glossy color accent
steps: Apply an even lip-color layer with a deliberate outline to balance the defined eyes.

makeup.title: Warm bronze mood
makeup.summary: Peach color, natural-brown definition and a warm brick lip over a radiant base. This direction explores warmth without requiring an all-over bronzer.
makeup.finish: Radiant base with a choice of matte or glossy lips
makeup.colorNotes: Peach Mate Apple and Good Brick supply the warm color cues. Sunkissed gloss is an optional finish, not a verified color match to the tint.
makeup.technique: Repeat a warm color cue across eyes, cheeks and lips while keeping brown definition selective.

selections.reason: Radiant liquid foundation gives an even-looking base; 10C Shell must be shade-matched and does not determine your undertone.
Peach Mate Apple offers matte, satin and shimmer eye textures; inspect the individual colors before choosing your warm accent.
Boksoonga Tok brings peach-toned liquid cheek color; how it blends with this foundation has not been verified.
Natural Brown pencil adds fine brow definition; the shade is an example and net content remains unverified.
Good Brick provides a warm, pigmented matte lip option; build gradually because its color is not personalized.
Sunkissed gloss is an alternative sheer, shiny lip finish; it can feel tingly, and layering over the tint is untested.

steps: Choose a foundation shade independently of this warm color theme and apply the coverage you want.
Use a peach eye accent and fine brown brow strokes; add shimmer only where desired.
Blend the peach liquid blush and check the overall color balance.
Choose the brick matte tint or the sheer gloss as your lip finish; using both is optional.

brows.title: Fine brown strokes
steps: Use short natural-brown strokes where you want more brow definition, then blend the edges.

eyes.title: Peach and soft shimmer
steps: Select a peach-toned eye shade from the palette and add a small shimmer accent if desired.

nose.title: Keep the base shade true
steps: Keep the nose in your matched foundation shade; the warm theme comes from color accents, not a darker base.

cheeks.title: Peach liquid flush
steps: Blend a small amount of peach liquid blush and repeat only if you want stronger color.

lips.title: Brick or sheer shine
steps: Choose softly blended brick tint for matte contrast, or use Sunkissed gloss for a sheer finish.

makeup.title: Cherry lip focus
makeup.summary: Make a glossy cherry lip the strongest color. Keep the base even and the eye line fine so the lip reads clearly.
makeup.finish: Even complexion with a high-shine lip focus
makeup.colorNotes: Hushed Cherry is the main color. Kaya Beige is an optional outline reference; verify that it blends with your lips and chosen tint.
makeup.technique: Spend the definition on the lip border and keep eye and cheek accents restrained.

selections.reason: A liquid base option for evening visible tone; 2 Lingerie needs a shade check and net content is unverified.
A narrow-tip concealer can provide targeted coverage instead of an all-over base; matching shade names do not prove a match.
A slim black pencil keeps the eye line controlled; waterproof labeling does not establish a compatible remover.
Long Lash Curling mascara adds definition with a modest eye-color footprint; personal tolerance and removal need checking.
Kaya Beige lip pencil can help define and blend the border; swatch it with your lip color before pairing.
Hushed Cherry gives the glossy cherry accent; the catalog uses an import reference and exact regional details remain limited.

steps: Choose targeted concealer or an all-over foundation, according to the coverage you want.
Keep the eye line narrow and add lash definition without a competing strong eye color.
If the lip pencil suits your chosen tint, blend it along the lip border; otherwise skip it.
Apply the cherry tint evenly and refine the outline. Keep additional cheek color optional.

brows.title: Understated brow frame
steps: Brush brows into your preferred shape and keep added color restrained.

eyes.title: A fine line
steps: Use a narrow black lash line and modest mascara definition so the lip remains the strongest accent.

nose.title: Even, quiet base
steps: Blend targeted coverage around the nose if desired and leave extra contour optional.

cheeks.title: Keep the color focus on lips
steps: Keep cheeks at your chosen base finish or add only a small amount of your familiar cheek color.

lips.title: Glossy cherry focal point
steps: Refine the lip border, then build an even cherry-gloss finish to the intensity you want.

skincare.title: Keep it minimal
skincare.summary: Explore one cleanser, one moisturizer and a daytime sunscreen. Keep familiar products that already suit your routine.
skincare.technique: Start with the roles you need and add extra layers only when you want them.

selections.reason: A water-based cleanser for everyday washing; the brand does not position it as a standalone makeup remover.
A daily moisturizing cream for a simple middle step; the catalog's partial ingredient list cannot clear your exclusions.
A verified U.S. broad-spectrum SPF 50 option for the daytime step; personal tolerance still needs checking and label directions apply.

steps: Keep your own suitable products for any roles you already cover.
Use the cleanser according to its directions, then apply your chosen moisturizer.
For the daytime sunscreen step, follow the sunscreen label's application and reapplication directions.
If wearing makeup, check its removal instructions separately; this simple guide does not verify a remover pairing.

skincare.title: Cushioned hydration
skincare.summary: A hydrating liquid and a richer cream create a more cushioned-feeling routine. The toner and essence are alternatives to explore.
skincare.technique: Choose one liquid hydration step first, then finish with a cream texture you enjoy.

selections.reason: A hydrating toner option with propolis; bee-derived ingredients are present and personal tolerance is not established.
A hydrating essence alternative to the toner; it contains snail-derived material and is not a verified tolerance match.
A richer cream texture for the cushioned finish; the evidence does not promise relief or establish ingredient compatibility.
A moisturizing U.S. broad-spectrum SPF 45 option for daytime; tolerance and how it layers with your products still need checking.

steps: Begin with your usual cleansing step if needed.
Choose the toner or the essence as your liquid hydration step; both are optional rather than a required pair.
Apply your chosen cream according to its directions and adjust the number of layers to your preference.
For daytime, follow the sunscreen label. Keep any ingredient exclusions active when comparing these examples.

skincare.title: Lightweight layers
skincare.summary: A light ampoule and gel cream offer hydration with less emphasis on rich textures. Select this for the feel you prefer, not an assumed skin type.
skincare.technique: Keep each layer simple and skip the ampoule if the gel cream alone gives the feel you want.

selections.reason: A gel-to-foam cleanser option for this routine; it is fragranced and personal tolerance remains unverified.
A light, non-sticky ampoule for an optional hydration layer; the product is not confirmed suitable from a photo or skin label.
A gel-cream alternative to a rich moisturizer; its cooling or comfortable feel is not guaranteed for every user.
A lightweight-feeling U.S. SPF 50 option for daytime; finish and compatibility with these layers must be checked personally.

steps: Use the cleanser as directed or keep your current cleansing product.
Add the light ampoule only if you want a separate hydration step.
Apply the gel cream and assess the texture before adding another layer.
For daytime, use sunscreen according to its label rather than reducing the labeled application to make the routine feel lighter.

skincare.title: Comfort before makeup
skincare.summary: Explore a light hydration step, moisturizer and daytime sunscreen before color cosmetics. The serum and mist are optional alternatives.
skincare.technique: Keep preparation focused, then check how your own base makeup sits over it.

selections.reason: A light hydration serum option before moisturizer; better makeup wear or compatibility with a foundation is not established.
A lightweight cream option before complexion makeup; this guide does not infer a skin concern or promise a reaction-free result.
A moisturizing broad-spectrum SPF 45 option for daytime preparation; foundation SPF does not replace this labeled sunscreen step.
An optional hydrating mist-serum format instead of another serum layer; it is not verified here as a makeup setting spray.

steps: Begin with your familiar cleansing step and choose either a serum or mist if you want extra hydration.
Apply your chosen moisturizer and follow the products' directions before layering makeup.
For daytime, apply sunscreen as its label directs and observe any labeled waiting time.
Try a small amount of your chosen base makeup to check the finish; add a makeup primer only if you want that separate step.
